sisi.depan: A colossal 300-meter spire of dark metal encased in black ice rises from the plaza, its intricate gold batik-patterned lines unlit and a great cracked socket for a core sitting at its base.
sisi.kanan: A long, collapsed arcade of heavy stone pillars lies in a jumble of snow-covered wreckage, revealing the dark, hollowed-out interiors of the buildings behind it.
sisi.belakang: The two halves of a massive, non-symmetrical split gateway of dark, carved stone stand askew, framing a desolate view of snow-swept ruins beyond the plaza.
sisi.kiri: The skeletal frame of a large, open-sided joglo pavilion with a distinctive, multi-tiered tumpang sari roof structure has caved in under the weight of accumulated ice and snow.

tengah: The wide, circular basin of an ornamental pool, its surface a sheet of cracked, opaque ice, surrounds the monument's central plinth, with drifts of snow piled against its frozen edge.
atas: A perpetual twilight sky is obscured by a thick, oppressive ceiling of swirling dark clouds from which snow falls continuously, obscuring the top of the spire.
